basic_details.job_title: ESIC Hospital Tiruppur Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 18 Specialist, Senior Resident Posts
basic_details.short_information: Employees State Insurance Corporation Hospital, Tiruppur (ESIC Hospital, Tiruppur) is recruiting candidates for 18 vacancies including Specialist (Full Time) - Psychiatry, Senior Resident - Anaesthesiology, Senior Resident - Dermatology, Senior Resident - General Medicine, Senior Resident - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Senior Resident - Orthopaedics, Senior Resident - General Surgery and Senior Resident - ICU on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend a walk-in interview on 3 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM, at ESIC Hospital, Pooluvapatti to Thirumurugan poondi Ring Road, Tiruppur. T

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Age Proof (Class 10th certificate or Birth certificate) MBBS Certificate along with mark sheets PG Degree/Diploma Certificate along with mark sheets ID Proof Address Proof Two recent Passport size photographs Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC and I&A Certificate for EWS candidates (OBC/EWS certificates must be as per Central Govt. Performa and valid as on the date of interview) MCI/SMC Registration Certificate with MD/MS/DNB qualification No Objection Certificate from present employer (if applicable, also required for Doctors under Bond) Experience Certificate, if applicable Demand Draft for application fee of Rs. 300/- drawn in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at "Tiruppur" (NIL for SC/ST/PWD candidates) Duly filled application form along with original documents and one set of self-attested copies

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the venue between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM for document verification. Only candidates whose documents are verified successfully will be allowed to attend the walk-in interview. Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- through a DD or Bankers Cheque drawn in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at Tiruppur.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Hospital, Tiruppur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 3 November 2026, with document verification starting from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at ESIC Hospital, Pooluvapatti to Thirumurugan poondi Ring Road, Tiruppur - 641603.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies are available for Full Time Specialist and Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for Full Time Specialists?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 67 years on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years on the date of interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Serviceman as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What salary is offered for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Senior Residents receive a consolidated remuneration of approximately Rs. 1,49,284/- per month along with applicable DA revisions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 300/- paid via Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at Tiruppur. SC/ST/PWD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: These posts are purely on a contractual basis. Full Time Specialists are engaged for a 3-year term (initially one year, extendable on an annual basis), and Senior Residents are engaged for a 3-year term.

faq.question: Q9. Is private practice allowed for contractual doctors?
faq.answer: Private practice of any kind is not allowed for full-time contractual engagements.
